news.title: Seized Iranian Oil Tankers Head Toward U.S. With $600 Million Cargo
news.summary: Two of the Iran-linked oil supertankers interdicted by American naval forces early in the war are just weeks away from reaching the US, where authorities have pledged to seize the vessels and millions of dollars worth of crude that they’re transporting.

news.title: Gulf of Oman Ship-to-ship Oil Transfers Reach Limit as Saudi Exports Surge
news.summary: Ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman for Middle Eastern oil from inside the Strait of Hormuz have reached their limits after Saudi Arabia diverted exports from the Red Sea, adding to shipments from other producers, trade sources and analysts said.

news.title: Qatar Boosts LNG Traffic Via Hormuz as Global Shortage Bites
news.summary: Qatar has ramped up liquefied natural gas tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz to the highest in more than two months, a sign it’s becoming more comfortable moving ships through the waterway.

news.title: US-Sanctioned Oil Tanker ‘Sibu 1’ Rescued from Somali Pirates
news.summary: A US-sanctioned oil tanker, Sibu 1, has been freed after being hijacked by Somali pirates in August, the maritime police force in Somalia's semi-autonomous Puntland region said on Friday.
